result.instructions: Tools for JustCall, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which calls did we miss yesterday, and who called back?"; "Show the texts we sent to this customer this week."; "Send a text to this contact from our main JustCall number.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes JustCall data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run justcall_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run justcall_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run justcall_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. justcall_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: justcall_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List calls on the account, optionally filtered by agent, direction, contact number, JustCall number and date range. Returns call ids, direction, status, duration and timestamps. GET /v2.1/calls.

agent_id.description: Only calls handled by this agent id.

call_direction.description: Only incoming or only outgoing calls.

contact_number.description: Only calls with this contact phone number.

justcall_number.description: Only calls on this JustCall number.

from_datetime.description: Start or end, as yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

to_datetime.description: Start or end, as yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

tools.name: justcall_get_call
tools.title: Get a call
tools.description: Get one call by id: duration, direction, status, timestamps, notes and disposition. GET /v2.1/calls/{id}.

tools.name: justcall_get_call_journey
tools.title: Get a call journey
tools.description: Get the journey of a completed call: the ring and routing steps it went through. Not available while a call is in progress. GET /v2.1/calls/{id}/journey.

tools.name: justcall_get_call_voice_agent
tools.title: Get voice agent data for a call
tools.description: Get the AI voice agent insights and metadata for a completed call. Not available while a call is in progress. GET /v2.1/calls/{id}/voice-agent.

annotations.title: Get voice agent data for a call

tools.name: justcall_get_account_call_analytics
tools.title: Get account call analytics
tools.description: Get account-level call analytics for a date range: call volume, average ring time, total duration, SLA performance, connect and answer rates. GET /v2.1/calls/analytics/account.

tools.name: justcall_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts, optionally filtered by name, phone number or status. By default only the owner's contacts; set across_team to include every agent's contacts. GET /v2.1/contacts.

across_team.description: Include contacts of all agents on the account.

tools.name: justcall_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, including its notes and other phone numbers. GET /v2.1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: justcall_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact in JustCall with a first name and phone number, and optional last name, company, email, address and notes. Creates a new record each time. POST /v2.1/contacts.

tools.name: justcall_update_contact_status
tools.title: Update contact status
tools.description: Add or remove one existing contact (by id or phone number) from the DND, DNM or blacklist lists. Adding a list twice gives the same result. PUT /v2.1/contacts/status.

across_team.description: Update the contact for all agents, not only the owner.

add_to.description: Lists to add the contact to.

remove_from.description: Lists to remove the contact from.

tools.name: justcall_list_texts
tools.title: List texts
tools.description: List SMS messages, optionally filtered by phone numbers, direction, content or date range. GET /v2.1/texts.

contact_number.description: Only texts with this contact phone number.

justcall_number.description: Only texts on this JustCall number.

sms_direction.description: Only incoming or only outgoing texts.

sms_content.description: Only texts that contain this text.

from_datetime.description: Start or end, as yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

to_datetime.description: Start or end, as yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

tools.name: justcall_get_text
tools.title: Get a text
tools.description: Get one SMS by id: direction, agent number, contact number and delivery status. GET /v2.1/texts/{id}.

tools.name: justcall_list_text_threads
tools.title: List text threads
tools.description: List SMS threads for one SMS-enabled JustCall phone number. Use justcall_list_phone_numbers to find its phone_id. GET /v2.1/texts/threads.

phone_id.description: Id of the SMS-enabled JustCall phone number.

tools.name: justcall_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS
tools.description: Send one SMS from a JustCall number to one contact number. It is sent at once unless schedule_at is set. A sent SMS cannot be recalled. POST /v2.1/texts/new.

justcall_number.description: The JustCall number to send from.

schedule_at.description: Send time, as the API accepts it. Omit to send now.

tools.name: justcall_list_phone_numbers
tools.title: List phone numbers
tools.description: List the JustCall phone numbers on the account with their ids, capabilities and assigned agents. Use these ids and numbers in the other tools. GET /v2.1/phone-numbers.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with JustCall
prompts.description: What you can do with JustCall here, with example requests to try.
